source_handle: 18 28 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local iodophor disinfection, local infiltration anesthesia with 4% articaine, separation of the gums after the anesthesia takes effect, extraction of loose teeth, routine scraping of the extraction socket, reduction of the extraction socket, and cotton ball compression to stop bleeding.
